# Hypotheses

### Domain Hypothesis {.hypotheses-slide}

::: {.hypothesis-stack}

::: {.fragment .fade-in .hyp-mini}
![](img/main_results/hypothesis_h1.svg){.hyp-img fig-alt="H1"}

H1: loss domain $\rightarrow$ *less* social comparison
:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in .hyp-mini}
Why?
:::

:::

### Domain Mediated Hypotheses {.hypotheses-slide}

::: {.hypothesis-stack}

::: {.fragment .fade-in .hyp-mini}
![](img/main_results/hypothesis_non_tested_hp.svg){.hyp-img fig-alt="Non-tested hypothesis: psychological discomfort mediates the relation between domain and social comparison"}

Non-tested HP: loss domain $\rightarrow$ *more* psychological discomfort $\rightarrow$ *less* social comparison
:::


::: {.fragment .fade-in .hyp-mini}
![](img/main_results/hypothesis_identification_h2.svg){.hyp-img fig-alt="H2: identification mediates the relation between domain and social comparison"}

H2: loss domain $\rightarrow$ *more* identification $\rightarrow$ *less* social comparison
:::

:::

### Direction Hypothesis {.hypotheses-slide}

::: {.hypothesis-stack}

::: {.fragment .fade-in .hyp-mini}
![](img/main_results/hypothesis_direction_h3.svg){.hyp-img fig-alt="H3"}

H3: *higher* probability of upward comparison $\rightarrow$ *more* social comparison
:::

:::

## Exploratory Results

### Model 1 {.interval-model-slide .exploratory-model-slide}

:::: {.exploratory-model-layout}

::: {.exploratory-plot-panel}
::: {.exploratory-plot}
![](img/main_results/hurdle_marginal_probability_any_sampling_by_interval.png){fig-alt="Marginal probability of any sampling by outcome difference"}
:::

::: {.interval-contrast-summary}
Outcome difference 40-20: `b = 0.513`, `SE = 0.239`, `p = .032`
Outcome difference 40-10: `b = 0.585`, `SE = 0.240`, `p = .015`
:::
:::

::: {.model-variables}
<div class="model-variables-title">Model Variables</div>

**Dependent variable**

Sample count

**Displayed outcome**

Probability of any sampling

**Independent variables**

- Outcome difference
- Outcome type
- Domain
:::

::::
